@name: Fighter
@slug: fighter
@realms: Mentalism
@prime_stats: Co, St
@description:
 Fighters are non spell users who will find it relatively easy to develop a
 variety of different weapons and to wear heavier types of armor. They are
 less skilled in maneuvering and manipulating mechanical devices such as locks
 and traps (though they are still superior to most spell users in these
 areas). They have the greatest difficulty learning anything connected with
 spells. Some literary examples of a Fighter might include Conan the
 Barbarian, Little John, and Gimli the Dwarf.
